name: Kingstar Office Cupboard with Glass Doors (KKOC013)
description: 4-door wooden cupboard with glass upper doors and solid lower doors. Ideal for display and storage in living rooms or offices.
details: This storage cupboard features two glass doors on the upper section for display and two solid doors on the lower section for secure storage. It has multiple adjustable shelves inside, black handles and locking systems on both sections. The wood-grain finish gives a smart, professional look. Suitable for living rooms, offices or study areas in Sri Lankan homes.
